Dmitri: Heads-up — EU1 p99 lag creeping ~1400ms past 02:10 UTC. Charts show queue depth spike and GPU utilization at 78%. Thinking we need to tighten the gamma admission threshold or add a short prewarm.
Asha: saw that, queue depth up from 5 -> 22 over ~3m. Region interconnect had small packet loss around same time, could be a retry storm. :mag:
Ben: quick sim shows with current service rate (avg tokens/sec ~45 per GPU) and arrival ~210 req/s we hit p99 > 1s when queue > 15. Posting calc below.
Ben: ```calc
arrival = 210 req/s
avg_tokens = 80 tokens/req
gpu_tps = 3600 tokens/s (per GPU)
req_per_gpu = gpu_tps / avg_tokens = 45 req/s
needed_gpus = ceil(arrival / req_per_gpu) = ceil(210 / 45) = 5
for p99 headroom target (+40%) => target_gpus = ceil(5 * 1.4) = 7
```
Asha: that matches my roughs. Our autoscaler currently only adds 1 GPU per 60s — too slow for a sudden spike.
Dmitri: can we instead add a soft-fallback to a smaller model (redwood-small) when queue_depth > 12? That would cut token demand roughly 2.5x and avoid hot scale.
Caroline: +1 on fallback. Cost/quality note: redwood-small reduces token cost but has regressions on code-gen. For chat and summarization it's usually fine.
Ben: alternative to fallback is to tighten the gamma/admission threshold from 18 -> 12; tradeoff is higher rejects. My estimate: rejected fraction at peak would be ~12% => ~2.5 req/s at peak.
Asha: suggestion: combine approaches — bump scaler cooldown to 20s (faster adds), implement soft admission at 14 with immediate dynamic fallback to redwood-small for overflow, and alert if rejected rate > 10% for >60s.
Dmitri: @deploy-bot can we roll a config hotfix to EU1 for autoscaler and admission policy now? We want minimal blast radius then can widen. :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollout triggered by Dmitri — change set: autoscaler/cooldown=20s, admission/soft_threshold=14, fallback_model=redwood-small. Canary: 2% traffic EU1. ETA ~8m.
Caroline: I'll run the critical prompt set against redwood-small for top 10 customer flows — initial runs look ok for chat-summary, flagging code-gen flows.
Ben: quick back-of-envelope cost delta for a 3-hour event: baseline (7 GPUs * 3h) = 21 GPUh; fallback mix estimate (5 base GPUs + 2 small-model equivalents where small ~0.35 cost of base) => 5*3 + 2*(3*0.35) = 15 + 2.1 = 17.1 GPUh -> ~18.6% savings.
Asha: logging checklist before we finish: add queue_depth histogram (1s buckets), per-model reject rate, fallback_count/min, and correlate with interconnect error rate.
Dmitri: actionable owners: Ben validate numerics & run 1k-run bootstrap sim; Caroline finish quality checks and thumbs for safe flows; Asha update dashboards/alerts and add logs. Reconvene in 30m unless canary shows regressions.
Caroline: noted, will post quality matrix once done.
Ben: will push sim results to the thread in ~12m.
Dmitri: thanks all — appreciate quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
